title: Needs grilling column and grill command
description: HANDOVER §4 Needs grilling. Column needs-grilling after backlog. Asking never moves a card; agents move a card there explicitly when blocked on the human. The grilling session answers via the CLI and moves the card to todo when no questions remain open. init adds the column; existing boards get it once via the board.json 1.1.0 upgrade-on-read. Depends on Q&A and versioning.

acceptanceCriteria.text: init creates needs-grilling; board.json 1.1.0 upgrade inserts it once (after backlog, else first) and is not re-added if removed
grill [ID] prints cards in the column with their open questions as a grilling brief
SKILL.md: when agents move cards to Needs grilling; grilling answers via CLI and moves cards to todo
Tests cover the command, column and upgrade
